fusions.name: Wading Kick
fusions.desc: A kick carried by river water that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%). Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Boot Full of River
fusions.desc: Kicks a cone of cold, muddy water 4 tiles ahead, dealing 4 damage to everything in it, with a 35% chance to leave each target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Cool Footbath
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Mile by Mile
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, you regain 3 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
